text.tspan: Scenario: Stage 3 base setting, test/victory.txt, from turn 13. C4 sits at table 2 with a READY combo, table 1 is free, Happy Hour was used on turns 10 and 11.
The Waiter has two useful tasks and may do only one. That choice decides whether a fifth customer pays before turn 18.
TURN 13 - one pass of the while loop in GameController.startGame()
guard is false here (Happy Hour already used), so there is no prompt
c5's order is then taken one turn later, on turn 14. The combo is READY on turn 16, SERVED on turn 17,
and c5 is only READY_TO_PAY on turn 18, too late to be charged. Final result: 4 paid customers, $64.08.
[choice = 2 - take c5's order first (the recorded victory run)]
TURNS 14 AND 15 - the Chef finishes the combo (on turn 14 the Waiter serves c4)
The Waiter acts before the Chef, so a dish finished this turn can be served on the next turn at the earliest.

svg.text: seat(c5, table1, queue), inherited from Staff
ActionResult success, c5 ordered the combo
ActionResult failure, nobody ready to pay
